about_the_game:
Step into the spotlight, survive the swarm, and become the last star standing. Can you satisfy the bloodthirsty audience and stage a massacre worthy of prime-time ratings?

In the not-so-distant future, humanity has mastered the art of cloning — only to use it for one thing: turning clones into zombies for a blood-soaked TV survival show. Your goal? Survive as long as possible with the help of combat drones, deadly traps, and an insatiable thirst for ratings.

Game features:

  • Top-down tactical mayhem – fast, unforgiving combat where clever trap use and deadly drones can turn the tide.

  • Combat drones – summon, upgrade, and combine drones with unique abilities and combat roles.

  • Deadly arenas – procedurally generated layouts make every run a fresh and deadly challenge.

  • Traps & upgrades – freeze, burn, blast, and outsmart the undead in creative ways.

  • Dark satire & bloody style – a brutal parody of reality TV where every kill boosts your ratings.

    About the Game & Developer

    ZDSS: Zombie Drone Survival Show is an indie passion project developed by DYV, a solo developer with a love for roguelikes, zombies, and explosive top-down chaos.

    It’s more than just a survival shooter — it’s one dev’s dream to create the bloodiest show on Earth.

    Join the community, share your ideas, and help shape the game — your support means everything.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7/10/11
  • Processor: i5-4670K @ 3.40GHz or similar
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce 970 or better
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

short_description: Welcome to the bloodiest show of the future! In this explosive rogue-lite arena shooter, you command deadly combat drones to survive endless waves of cloned zombies. Deploy traps, upgrade your arsenal, and turn the arena into a brutal spectacle—all under the spotlight of a dystopian reality show.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Russian, Japanese
